ml_lc.note: Grouped into 4 classes (forest, other vegetation, built-up/bare, water) the NISAR + terrain model is right 88% of the time (kappa 0.82), and separates forest from non-forest 93% of the time (89% from NISAR alone); accuracies are on class-balanced test samples. Of 5,255 km2 mapped, 86% agrees with 2020; possible changes: forest to non-forest 23 km2, vegetation to built-up/bare 104 km2, land to water 15 km2. Optical landslide pixels were flagged as radar change twice as often as average land (28% vs 14%).

rain.source: GPM IMERG V07 monthly Final (1998-01..2025-09) + daily Late Run summed (scaled x0.966) to Oct 2026; box 124.3-125.8E, 5.3-6.7N
